name: Kalker’s linear creep theory
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 在小蠕滑条件下描述轮轨切向力与蠕滑关系的理论。
usage_note: 正文明确其仅适用于小蠕滑，并针对较大蠕滑进行非线性修正。
usage_overview: 常用于车辆—轨道动力分析，建立蠕滑率与轮轨切向力、自旋力矩的线性联系，也可据蠕滑系数构造等效阻尼。其适用范围为小蠕滑；涉及较大蠕滑时，常以线性计算结果为基础引入非线性饱和修正。

complete_examples.text: L. XU ET AL. The wheel–rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by the use of Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified by the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [25].

The wheel-rail interaction forces mainly include wheel– rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by the use of Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified by the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins nonlinear model (Shen et al. 1983).

The wheel-rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal direc-tions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by Kalker’s linear creep theory [19] and then modified with the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins nonlinear model [20].

The wheel–rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified with the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [40].

Since the Kalker’s linear creep theory is only suited to the cases with small creepages, the nonlinear modification was conducted for the situations of large creepages by the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins model [22].

For the calculation of wheel-rail normal contact forces, the nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory is used to calculate the wheel-rail normal contact force, while the wheel-rail longitudinal and lateral creep forces are obtained based on the Kalker’s linear creep theory.

Based on wheel-rail spatially coupling model [5], the wheel-rail spatial contact in geometry can be fully considered, besides Kalker’s linear creep theory and nonlinear modification formula by Shen, Hedrick and Elkins [33] are introduced.

The wheel-rail normal contact force is computed based on Hertz’s nonlinear elastic contact the ory, whereas the creep forces are determined using Kalker’s linear creep theory with nonlinear corrections implemented through Johnson-Vermeulen theory.

The well-known nonlinear Hertz contact theory and Kalker’s linear creep theory with nonlinear modifications have been introduced in the wheel–rail coupled dynamic model [39] with refined description of the contact geometry and nonlinear characterization of the contact forces in normal and tangential directions.
